name: Travelling Merchant
description: A merchant cart parks on the road tile for 2 days. Trades meat and eggs for rare seed packets and bee queens.

name: Stray Animal
description: A feral chicken or semi-wild goat wanders onto the farm. Adopt for +1 stock or chase off for +5 morale.

name: Dead Log Discovery
description: A forest-edge deadfall drops 40 wood. Claim it within 3 days before a woodpecker starts harvesting.

name: Heritage Seed Found
description: A foraging fairy finds a rare heritage seed - unlocks a higher-tier plant for one planting.

name: Wandering Fairy
description: An unaffiliated fairy offers to join the farm, bypassing normal population growth.

name: Old Letter
description: A parchment scrap from the ruin hints at a buried tool or seed cache. A pin appears on the map.

name: Lost Duckling
description: A lost duckling wanders in. Save it for a free duck pair next spring, or let it go.

name: Bear Visit
description: A bear passes through, eats 2 apples, leaves manure on path tiles.

name: Salmon Scout
description: A single coho scouts the stream. Promises a salmon run if riparian health stays high.

name: First Frost Whisper
description: A two-day warning banner before autumn's first frost.

name: Rainbow over the Ruin
description: A rainbow arcs over the ruin. Fairies crowd around (+5 morale).

name: Windfall Apples
description: A wild crabapple drops a burst of fruit across nearby tiles.

name: Comfrey Bloom
description: Wild comfrey is K-charged today; chop-and-drop yields double.

name: Hummingbird Arrival
description: Indicator species - the first hummingbird visits. Requires flower diversity 6+.

name: Neighbor's Lost Goat
description: A neighbor's goat has wandered onto the farm. Return it for a trade favor, or keep it and accept a guilt debuff.

name: Moss Bloom
description: Moisture + shade crosses a threshold - moss carpet spreads one tile.

name: Chanterelle Sprout
description: A wild chanterelle pushes up in an oak-hazel guild tile.

name: Firefly Night
description: Vitality above 0.7 at night conjures fireflies over the pond.

name: Mason Bee Swarm
description: A mason bee swarm finds the tubes - pollination rate spikes for a week.

name: Bird Nest Discovery
description: A foraging fairy finds a bird nest; no eggs, but the area is now a protected zone.

name: Mushroom Flush
description: Overnight rain triggers a burst of wild mushrooms at the forest edge.

name: Honeybee Split
description: A hive splits; a swarm launches toward the oldest apple tree.

name: Chipmunk Stash
description: A fairy spots a chipmunk seed stash; a small pile of assorted seeds appears at the stash tile.

name: Owl on Post
description: An owl roosts on a fence post. Rodent pressure drops for a week.

name: Truffle Whiff
description: A truffle-hinting scent near an old hazel. Decades-mode only.

name: Lightning Snag
description: A lightning strike turns an old tree into a snag. Cavity-nesters arrive in future weeks.

name: Migratory Flock
description: A migratory flock passes overhead; gives the day a cinematic bump.
